recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate The Iron Oracle as a single-file browser Canvas game. Preserve the source falling-target tap mechanics exactly: targets spawn on a timer, fall downward, normal targets are worth +10, bonus targets are worth +50, hazards cost one life when tapped, missed non-hazards cost one life, empty taps do nothing, three lives cause game over, and restart resets the run. Rebuild the presentation as a dramatic Game of Thrones inspired dark-fantasy realm ruled by an evil AI assistant. Use procedural raven, crown, and blood-directive silhouettes; an AI throne sigil; gold/blood/ice/iron palette; Cinzel fantasy typography plus Orbitron AI typography; mobile-safe HUD labels Influence and Houses; and gesture-safe dark audio from approved catalogs.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first falling-target tap arcade game on a full-screen canvas
- objective: tap falling non-hazard targets before they leave the screen to gain score
- input model: pointer/touch/click on the playfield; empty taps have no penalty; restart button uses native click
- core loop: auto-start play, spawn targets over time, targets fall, player taps targets, score/lives update, difficulty slowly increases through faster spawning/falling pressure
- fail/friction state: missed non-hazard targets or tapped hazards remove lives; three lost lives trigger game over and restart

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve timed spawn cadence, falling motion, circular hit detection, score values (+10 normal, +50 bonus), hazard penalty, missed-target life loss, three-life game over, restart reset, no penalty for empty taps, and mobile pointer actionability.

## Remix Blueprint
The rebuilt game is The Iron Oracle: a dramatic throne-war arcade where an evil AI assistant claims a medieval realm. Normal targets are raven decrees to purge for +10 influence, bonus targets are crown writs for +50, red triangular hazards are blood directives that cost a house/life, and missed loyal decrees cost a house when they escape.

identity.identity: A dramatic dark-fantasy tap arcade game where an evil AI assistant sits on an iron throne and rains royal commands over a doomed realm.
